runs.label: Forge SWE-bench: re-runs of finished runs (not counted)
runs.notes: Nine finished Forge runs were first set aside because their cost could not be fully measured (a web search's helper model or a provider receipt without a price) and their instance was run again. One finished run per instance is the rule, so the first finished attempt is the counted one (in the official run); these are the later attempts, graded where the full run graded them. Their traces are here: each instance's trace file was overwritten by its last attempt.
